textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · The Chair · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The grandfather goes to the attic, which is a storage space just under the roof, and returns holding something Mario cannot see. He says it is a very special chair.

beats.en: The grandfather goes to the attic, which is a storage space just under the roof, and returns holding something Mario cannot see. He says it is a very special chair. Since it is invisible, it is tricky to sit on.
beats.speakEn: The grandfather goes to the attic, which is a storage space just under the roof, and returns holding something Mario cannot see. He says it is a very special chair. Since it is invisible, it is tricky to sit on.

beats.en: Brave and determined, Mario takes the invisible chair to school. At break time he asks everyone to form a circle and says they are about to see something amazing.
